description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'MessageCodeProducer' that is responsible for generating code related to IPC message handling, specifically in Java and native code contexts. It includes methods for obtaining message dependencies based on wrappers, likely used in code generation or serialization processes.

classes.name: MessageCodeProducer
classes.description: An abstract base class for producing code related to message serialization/deserialization for Java and native IPC, providing methods to gather dependencies based on wrappers.

methods.name: getMessageDependencies
methods.description: Returns an iterator over Wrappers that are dependencies for the message, filtered based on whether native code is targeted.

methods.name: scanWrappersForDependencies
methods.description: Filters a list of Wrappers, adding those that belong to the message section and match the language mask to a target list.
